d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, with the United States set to terminate South Africa’s duty-free access under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) on January 1, 2027, President Cyril Ramaphosa is aggressively pivoting towards new global trade partners. After Washington issued a formal 60-day termination notice—and months of strained bilateral ties sparked by steep US tariffs—Ramaphosa told lawmakers in Cape Town that Pretoria is not banking on a US policy reversal.
